# REQ: LANG-401 LANG-402 LANG-403 LANG-404 LANG-405
<#
  Block comment
#>
param(
    [string]$Name = "world",
    [int]$Times = 1
)

function Get-Greeting {
    param([string]$Who)
    $text = "Hello, $Who! Count: $($Times + 1)`n"
    $raw = 'single ''quoted'' $not'
    return $text * $Times + $raw
}

$here = @"
Here-string for $Name
"@

if ($Times -gt 0 -and $Name -ne $null) {
    Get-ChildItem -Path C:\temp -Filter *.txt | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_.Name }
} elseif ($true) {
    Write-Host (Get-Greeting -Who $Name)
}
$total = 0x1F + 1.5e3 + $false
foreach ($i in 1..3) { $total += $i }
